question: Explain the methods for determining the arm's length price of international transactions under the transfer pricing provisions.

points.label: Comparable Uncontrolled Price method
points.description: Compares the price charged in the controlled transaction with the price in a comparable uncontrolled transaction.

points.label: Resale Price Method
points.description: Starts from the price at which goods bought from an associated enterprise are resold to an unrelated party, less a normal gross margin.

points.label: Cost Plus Method
points.description: Adds a normal gross profit mark-up to the direct and indirect costs of production of goods or services provided to an associated enterprise.

points.label: Profit Split Method
points.description: Splits the combined profit from closely connected transactions between the enterprises based on their relative contributions.

points.label: Transactional Net Margin Method
points.description: Compares the net profit margin relative to an appropriate base (costs, sales, assets) with that of comparable uncontrolled transactions.

points.label: Other method and selection
points.description: Any other method prescribed by the Board may be used; the most appropriate method is chosen for the transaction.
